topic: 1-Minute TikTok Script to Book a Free Personal Training Trial
title: 1-Minute TikTok Script to Book Free PT Trials
title_options: How to Book Free Personal Training Trials Fast
One Text That Fills Your PT Trial Slots
Easy Script to Book Trial Clients Today
description:
A super-short TikTok/Shorts script you can copy to book free personal training trials. Designed for trainers with little time and zero ad budget.

Includes a single, cheap tactic, exact words to send, and visuals you can film in one take. Use this to get more trial bookings without complicated funnels.

scenes.narration: Fill every free PT slot in one week?
You run a gym or train clients and free trial slots sit empty because people forget to book.
Send a one-line SMS that creates urgency and makes booking one tap. Keep it personal and time-limited.
scenes.doodle_prompt: phone with a single message bubble and clock

scenes.narration: Copy this: “Hey Sam — I’ve got a free 45-min PT trial Friday at 5PM. Reply YES to claim it.”
If they reply YES, send: “Great — what’s your best phone number? I’ll text a quick confirmation and the gym address.”
scenes.doodle_prompt: trainer handing clipboard to a person, phone visible

scenes.narration: Film the message on-screen, show the empty slot filled, say: Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
